entt.owner_target: EngineCore scene implementation only; EnTT::EnTT private link
entt.verification: Official latest release and exact tag commit reviewed 2026-10-18. Official immutable commit archive downloaded and SHA-256 computed; MIT LICENSE and upstream CMake reviewed. CPU and sanitizer qualification is recorded separately in the 07a handoff.
entt.notes: FetchContent populates only the locked archive; Shark creates a SYSTEM C++20 header-only interface over src and does not execute the upstream CMake project (which unconditionally enables C). The listed optional upstream integrations are not evaluated, built or downloaded. No patches, code generation, installed-package fallback or transitive downloads. Core privately includes only entity/registry facilities; no third-party public types. Disconnected builds require a verified local SHARK_ENTT_ARCHIVE or the prior locked archive cache.

glm.owner_target: SharkMath public interface, linked publicly by EngineCore; all GLM access through shark/math.hpp
glm.verification: Official latest release and exact tag commit reviewed 2026-10-18. Official immutable commit archive downloaded and SHA-256 computed; complete copying.txt and upstream CMake reviewed. CPU and sanitizer qualification is recorded separately in the 07b handoff.
glm.notes: MIT option selected from the dual Happy Bunny/MIT offer; preserve the entire copying.txt. FetchContent populates only the locked archive; SharkMath supplies a SYSTEM C++20 header interface and the locked compile definitions. Upstream CMake is not executed, so library/tests/install/optional SIMD/global compiler options are not evaluated. No patches, installed-package fallback, transitive downloads or compiler ISA flags. Default right-handed, packed math types; the central public wrapper rejects conflicting configuration. Disconnected builds require verified SHARK_GLM_ARCHIVE or the prior locked archive cache.

runtime_audit.gcc_base_scope: Ubuntu gcc-14-base contains only directories and documentation, not compiler executables; retained runtime inventory is unchanged.

development_failures.detail: An initial format check used the plain shell without pinned clang-format on PATH; rerunning through windows_dev.ps1 passed. No source or host repair required.

The final independent shell audit caught CRLF in tools/ci/headless/chroot.sh. Normalized LF after both CPU matrices completed; exact before/after identity and repeated syntax/runtime audits are recorded in post_qualification_shell_amendment. No C++/tool semantics changed.

limits: CPU checkpoint only; no new GPU, frame, image or live MMO qualification.
Native Windows developer tools remain installed; relocated Runtime uses system-only PATH and cleared developer environment, not a second physical machine.
WSL shares the host kernel. SDK-free runtime is the retained userspace with isolated network and a writable rootfs.
Generational exhaustion is tested through production token/generation helpers; actual uint64 Scene slot exhaustion and private EnTT version wrap are not forced.
No schema, bounded revisioned semantic queries, scene serialization, authoring command/editor adapter, network protocol or distributed authority implementation yet.
Matrix math is scene-local; WorldPosition cells remain separate. M05 owns anchored roots, render/physics origins and seamless distributed handoff.
Strict local scale minimum and fixed matrix tolerances can conservatively reject keep-world near numerical thresholds; failure leaves the subtree unchanged.
Storage bounds do not establish performance or MMO capacity; general allocation-exhaustion recovery is not guaranteed.
